description: Solve 50+ classic riddles — type your answer, reveal it if you're stuck, and track your score.

faqs.a: Over 50 classic riddles, asked in random order with no repeats until the bank runs out.
Type your guess and press Enter. Matching is lenient — key words count, not exact phrasing.
A correct answer scores 10 points; revealing the answer scores nothing for that riddle.
Yes — the Show Answer button reveals it, then moves on. No penalty, but no points either.
faqs.q: Can I see the answer if I'm stuck?

howto: Press Start to get your first riddle.
Think, then type your answer and press Enter.
Stuck? Press Show Answer to reveal it.
Solve all 50+ riddles and beat your score!
title: Riddle Game
